definitions: The love grass, or quaking grass.

blocks.text: Senegalia riparia, commonly known as catch & keep, calumbi, jurema-branca, acacia zarza, amourette, and fleur du ben-aimé, is a thorny flowering plant of the family Fabaceae. It is native to Hispaniola, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, the Lesser Antilles,Trinidad, and northern South America.
